$comment: Inputs for tools/season_from_research.py: maps the 2020 entrants to pack teams, colours and tracks. Engines, weights and rules come from bases/dtm-era5, which builds on bases/dtm-era4 (car profiles, Hankook tyre, tracks). Colours are first estimates from the teams' usual colours, not yet checked against 2020 photos. rating_range is wider than era 4's because Audi won 16 of 18 races.
title: DTM 2020 - Deutsche Tourenwagen Masters

Audi Sport Team Rosberg.history: Keke Rosberg's team from Neustadt an der Weinstraße. Has raced Audis since 2006. René Rast won the 2017 and 2019 titles with the team.

Audi Sport Team Abt Sportsline.history: Hans-Jürgen Abt's team from Kempten. Has run Audis in the DTM since 2000.

Audi Sport Team Phoenix.history: Founded by Ernst Moser. Based in Meuspath, next to the Nürburgring. Has run Audis in the DTM since 2006.

BMW Team RMG.history: Stefan Reinhold's team from Andernach. Marco Wittmann won the 2014 and 2016 titles with the team.

BMW Team RMR.history: A BMW team run jointly by RMG and RBM. Entered since 2017.

BMW Team RBM.history: Founded by Bart Mampaey. Based in Mechelen, Belgium. Has run BMWs in the DTM since 2012.

Audi Sport Team WRT.history: Vincent Vosse's team from Belgium. Runs Audis in GT racing. Second DTM season in 2020, with three cars.

Orlen Team ART.history: Frédéric Vasseur's team from France. Ran Mercedes cars in the DTM in 2004 and 2005. Returns in 2020 with a customer BMW for Robert Kubica.

track_overrides.$comment: 2020 race laps (research/calendar.csv), one value per track for both races of a round. Spa and the Nürburgring Grand Prix circuit are the F1 base's tracks: speed_mult 1.09 is the ratio between the DTM and F1 Hockenheim tracks (same layout), a first guess until simulated. Assen and Zolder (zolder20, today's layout) are traced in bases/dtm-era5; dtm-1991's zolder is the Group A track and stays apart.
